summary: Frontend-only verification of mobile ring visibility & persistent player presenter cutout enlargement. All CSS/measurement checks passed. Mobile shows 5 .blend-ring-flash with mixBlendMode=normal and borderColor rgba(255,255,255,0.28); .blend-sphere width=340. Desktop unchanged: mixBlendMode=soft-light, borderColor rgba(255,255,255,0.5), sphere width=820. No horizontal overflow on 390 or 1920. Presenter cutout element not present on homepage (current show has no presenter.image) -> fallback path verified: persistent-player-play-btn is rendered without the cutout, so fallback CoverImage code path is active. Programma's page still loads.

issues: CSS values are correct (border alpha 0.28, mix-blend-mode normal, sphere 340) but visually the rings are very subtle on mobile screenshot against the near-navy background. If user still reports 'geen cirkels zichtbaar', consider bumping alpha to ~0.35-0.40 or adding a subtle box-shadow/glow on the rings for mobile. Currently within spec but borderline low-contrast.

action_items: Optional visual polish: on mobile, consider slightly higher ring border alpha (0.32-0.4) for stronger visibility of the concentric rings against dark navy background.

Presenter cutout data-testid was not present in DOM because the currently airing show on Koodh has no presenter.image; fallback path renders correctly. To fully validate test #4, seed/select a show that has presenter.image and retest.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile media-query overrides are scoped correctly (max-width:767px) and desktop path is fully preserved.
PersistentPlayer cutout height increase (calc(100% + 3.25rem)) could not be measured live because the current show has no presenter image; code path exists and fallback renders correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for measurable checks (test #4 N/A due to data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://blend-launch.preview.emergentagent.com uses long-lived streaming connections; use wait_until='domcontentloaded' instead of 'networkidle' to avoid Playwright timeouts. Presenter cutout only renders when useNowOnAir returns presenter.image; verify by checking current show on Koodh has a presenter image before asserting cutout height >=108px.
